about: Words a reader sees in each place at rest (the main region, on the fake engine; Money with the overview the real engine sends), measured by w3 package 3I on 26 October 2026 and again by w4 package 4Z on 27 October 2026, rounded up to the next 10. A baseline may only shrink: tests/budgets.test.tsx fails when a place grows past its number, or drops a whole step of 10 under it (then lower it), each place may not pass its first measure in "first" (rounded the same way), and the total may not pass firstTotal. Wave 5 measured all 27 places on 29 October 2026. Connections and Connections/AI measure 1804 words each (budgets 870 to 1810); onboarding measures 1148 (330 to 1150, first measure 340 to 1150); wave 6 package 6E6 shows the first 18 ways at rest with Show all, which measures 923 (1150 to 930) on 1 November 2026. Every rise is listed for the founder in the wave 5 PR; all other measured budgets are unchanged. Wave 6 English-only and desktop storage changes lowered 18 budgets on 30 October 2026; original first measures are preserved. Wave 6 package 6H1 adds the Apps place on 1 November 2026: 121 words at rest, budget and first measure 130, so firstTotal rises by 130 to 9080 for the new place only. Package 6J2 adds Business > Reports on 2 November 2026: 177 words at rest, budget and first measure 180, firstTotal 9260 for that new page only. "sheets" and "cards" (B4 task 11) hold the same for a sheet over its place and a card on Today, each with its first measure in "firstSheets" and "firstCards", and only shrink. One-shot C1 (6 November 2026): Settings' list is counted once, as the new `business` entry (the list alone at #/business on a phone), and not on every settings page; `work/ideas` is new, since Ideas left Work's filters for its own page. Both are first measures, so firstTotal rises by exactly those to 9430. Money's fewer tabs and the Settings strip's end lowered 15 baselines. Finding customers (14 November 2026) added the Find customers button to Clients, Pipeline: 191 words measured, so its budget and its first measure rose from 190 to 200 and firstTotal from 9670 to 9680, raised for the founder to confirm in the PR. The chief's standing plan (14 November 2026) raised two baselines, both listed for the founder and both still under their first measures: Today measures 550 words (510 to 550) with the chief's line for today, this week's moves with their states and the daily review's line beside the goal; Business > Routines measures 72 (60 to 80) with the Daily review listed as a routine. The platform's own risk where the AI is chosen (15 November 2026, the founder's rule "Show the platform's own risk in plain words") raised two baselines, both listed for the founder and both at their first measures, so firstTotal is unchanged: Connections and Connections/AI measure 1868 words each (1860 to 1870) with the engine's one line beside the AI app at rest, "Plans have limits made for one person, so heavy use can be cut off." Setup cards behind the week (15 November 2026) raised one baseline, listed for the founder and still under its first measure: Today measures 553 words (550 to 560), since the next best step is now the card that waits on the owner and one quiet line under it names the setup cards that also wait. The platform's own risk where the AI is chosen (15 November 2026, the founder's rule "Show the platform's own risk in plain words") raised two baselines, both listed for the founder and both at their first measures, so firstTotal is unchanged: Connections and Connections/AI measure 1868 words each (1860 to 1870) with the engine's one line beside the AI app at rest, "Plans have limits made for one person, so heavy use can be cut off." The old Start page (onboarding, 900 words at rest, first measure 1150) was removed on 15 November 2026, when every new business moved to the first run's own steps: its two entries are gone and firstTotal fell by its first measure, from 9680 to 8530. Nothing rose.
